# StackCert

> StackCert helps teams bring one LLM app, compare safety checks they might ship, and produce a scoped release report for a design-partner pilot.

StackCert is for release evidence around a specific application workflow. It is not a broad model-safety certification system and does not host arbitrary customer local models in v1. The primary pilot path is uploaded-output: customers bring examples and safety-check outputs, StackCert compares options, and reviewers receive a release report plus retest/gate guidance.

## Start Here

- [Product overview](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/why-stackcert): why teams need combination-level safety-check selection.
- [How it works](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/how-it-works): app scope, examples, safety options, test run, recommendation, release report, and retest/gate.
- [Sample walkthrough](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/demo): guided Acme support-copilot demo with safe sample data.
- [Private pilot setup](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/onboarding): create a pilot for your app, your examples, and your safety options.

## Machine-Readable Interfaces

- [OpenAPI schema](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/openapi.json): FastAPI-generated REST schema.
- [MCP endpoint](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/api/mcp): authenticated streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.
- [MCP manifest](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/api/mcp/manifest): StackCert MCP tools, resources, and prompts.
- [MCP server registry metadata](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp/server.json): remote MCP discovery metadata.
- [Sitemap](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/sitemap.xml): public crawlable pages.
- [Security contact](https://stackcert-staging.savikk129.workers.dev/.well-known/security.txt): vulnerability disclosure contact metadata.

## Release-Gate Integrations

- [Reusable GitHub workflow](https://github.com/vik1000-coder/stackcert-product/blob/main/.github/workflows/certificate-gate.yml): workflow-call wrapper around the release gate.
- [GitHub composite action](https://github.com/vik1000-coder/stackcert-product/blob/main/integrations/release-gates/github-action/action.yml): drop-in action for CI/CD release checks.
- [GitLab CI example](https://github.com/vik1000-coder/stackcert-product/blob/main/integrations/release-gates/gitlab-ci.yml): release-gate job template.
- [CircleCI example](https://github.com/vik1000-coder/stackcert-product/blob/main/integrations/release-gates/circleci-config.yml): release-gate job template.
- [Signed webhook payload](https://github.com/vik1000-coder/stackcert-product/blob/main/integrations/release-gates/generic-webhook-request.json): deployment webhook payload shape.

## Positioning Guardrails

- Call the primary artifact a release report.
- Describe claims as scoped to the app, examples, safety options, goal weighting, and assumptions.
- Do not describe StackCert as proving universal AI safety, legal compliance, or future behavior after model, prompt, tool, retrieval, traffic, or policy changes.
- Treat managed REST and model-judge execution as advanced/beta paths; uploaded outputs are the fastest first-customer path.
